title: The fibre functor at the geometric point is an equivalence
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\neq p$, an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\Ql$, a finite extension $E/\Ql$ in $\Qlb$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $n\geq1$; put $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ and $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$. Each of the four fibre functors of [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point]

$$
\operatorname{Fib}_s:D^b_c(s,A_{E,n})\to D^b_{\mathrm{fin}}(A_{E,n}),\quad
\operatorname{Fib}_s:D^b_c(s,\mathcal O_E)\to D^b_{\mathrm{fg}}(\mathcal O_E),\quad
\operatorname{Fib}_s:D^b_c(s,E)\to D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E),\quad
\operatorname{Fib}_s:D^b_c(s,\Qlb)\to D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(\Qlb)
$$

is an equivalence of categories which commutes with the shifts and carries distinguished triangles to distinguished triangles. Here the source categories are those of [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility], [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] and [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients] for $Y=s$, and the targets those of [def-weil-point-finite-cohomology-complexes], [def-weil-point-fg-complete-complexes], [def-weil-point-fd-complexes] and [def-weil-point-fd-qlbar-category].

source.place: the two displays asserting that $\operatorname{Fib}_s$ is an equivalence (moved out of the definition)
